purpose: Assess whether parameterwise routing behavior is stable when the text-only client is inactive; this is a joint participation-and-composition setting, not a causal missing-modality-ratio study.

realized_ratios.missing_modality_definition: active clients without both image and text divided by active clients

unrestricted.formula: Delta_p^U = sum_k(n_k * Delta_{k,p}) / sum_k(n_k), with Delta_{k,p}=0 for an unoptimized active client

restricted.eligible_clients: active clients whose modality is allowed for parameter group G(p)
restricted.empty_eligible_rule: preserve theta_p^t and write an aggregation audit event

parameter_group_analysis.VISION_ADAPTER_and_IMAGE_PARAMS: Compute image_only-versus-multimodal update cosine, angle, negative-cosine indicator, client relative drift/update RMS, and server drift. U and R have the same first-round eligible client set for these groups.
parameter_group_analysis.TEXT_ADAPTER_and_TEXT_PARAMS: Only multimodal has an uploaded update. Record client and server drift plus aggregation participation; pairwise conflict is undefined, not zero.
parameter_group_analysis.FUSION_PARAMS: Only multimodal has an uploaded update. Record client and server drift plus aggregation participation; pairwise conflict is undefined, not zero.
parameter_group_analysis.round_one_invariant: Under matched seed and controls, U and R client updates and pairwise conflict must match in round one; only server aggregation drift may differ.
